mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(FLOOR(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM upper(period) - lower(period)))), 0)::bigint FROM unnest((SELECT range_agg(period) FROM rtc_voice_time, LATERAL unnest(connected_periods) period WHERE user_id = #{userId})) period
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rtc_voice_time(participant_sid, room_sid, user_id, confirmed_at, observing) VALUES (#{participantSid}, #{roomSid}, #{userId}, #{at}, true) ON CONFLICT (participant_sid) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE rtc_voice_time SET connected_periods = connected_periods + tstzmultirange(tstzrange( CASE WHEN observing AND confirmed_at >= #{at}::timestamptz - INTERVAL '45 seconds' THEN confirmed_at ELSE #{at}::timestamptz END, #{at}, '[)')), confirmed_at = #{at}, observing = true WHERE participant_sid = #{participantSid} AND ended_at IS NULL AND confirmed_at <= #{at}
mapper.sql: SET connected_periods = (connected_periods * tstzmultirange(tstzrange(NULL, #{at}, '()'))) + CASE WHEN observing AND confirmed_at <= #{at} AND confirmed_at >= #{at}::timestamptz - INTERVAL '45 seconds' THEN tstzmultirange(tstzrange(confirmed_at, #{at}, '[)')) ELSE '{}'::tstzmultirange END, confirmed_at = LEAST(confirmed_at, #{at}), ended_at = #{at}, observing = false
mapper.update: UPDATE rtc_voice_time WHERE room_sid = #{roomSid} AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > #{at})
